specifications.Material: Virgin EVA + Carbon Textured PU Leather + Wire Coil

products.name: Signature Nappa Perforated Custom Seat Covers - Hyundai Creta

specifications.Package Content: Front Row (2), Rear Bench (60:40 split), 5 Headrests

products.warranty: 3 Years Warranty against peeling and cracking

products.description: Flagship automotive recording system featuring real 4K Front (3840x2160@30fps) + 1080P Rear cameras with Sony STARVIS 2 sensor, supercapacitor power cell, ADAS driver assist, 24/7 parking surveillance mode, and 5GHz Wi-Fi app connection.

specifications.Sensor: Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 Ultra Low Light

products.name: AeroLine Gloss Carbon Fiber Trunk Spoiler - Hyundai Creta
products.description: High-downforce aerodynamic rear lip spoiler hydro-dipped in authentic 3K twill carbon weave with automotive UV-cleared clearcoat. Installed cleanly using industrial 3M 5952 VHB tape without drilling body panels.

specifications.Material: High Impact ABS Polymer with 3K Carbon Finish

specifications.Aerodynamics: Reduces rear wake drag by up to 4.2%

products.name: AutoApex 7D Precision Deep Floor Mats for Tata Nexon (2020-2025)
products.description: Specifically engineered for Tata Nexon passenger cabin curves. Raised spill barrier walls guard against mud, slush, water, and debris. Removable top grass mat allows quick rinsing.

specifications.Material: Virgin EVA + Carbon Textured PU Leather
specifications.Fitment: Digitally measured Tata Nexon floor curvature

products.name: AeroFit Sport Contour Seat Covers for Tata Nexon

products.name: Rugged Central Armrest Console with Cup Holders - Mahindra Thar
products.description: Heavy-duty steel-reinforced drop-in central console armrest designed to eliminate fatigue during off-road and highway drives in the Mahindra Thar. Features dual cup holders, USB fast charger pass-through, and hidden locking valuables compartment.

specifications.Installation: Direct bolt-on to factory seat-bolt rails (no holes)
specifications.Compartments: Main tray, sunglass holster, dual 75mm cup holders

products.name: ApexGlide Heavy-Duty Illuminated Side Foot Steps - Toyota Fortuner
products.description: Aircraft-grade extruded aluminum side foot running boards engineered to sustain 250kg dynamic step load on Toyota Fortuner. Equipped with automatic LED puddle lighting strips that sync with door unlocking.

specifications.Lighting: IP68 Waterproof Cold White LED Strips

products.name: ApexShield Ultra 10H Graphene & Ceramic Paint Protection Kit
products.description: Professional grade 10H hardness liquid graphene nano-matrix coating for automotive exterior paint. Offers 5-year hydrophobic water-beading contact angle (>118°), swirl scratch resistance, chemical corrosion barrier, and mirror glass gloss.

specifications.Includes: 50ml Graphene Bottle, Applicator Block, 4 Suede Cloths, Gloves

products.name: AeroSens Solar Wireless TPMS Tire Pressure Monitor System

specifications.Display: Solar Powered Anti-Glare Color LCD Display
specifications.Sensors: 4 External Valves with Anti-Theft Lock Nuts

products.name: ApexShield 5-Layer All-Weather Waterproof Heavy Car Body Cover
products.description: Custom fitted for your specific car model. 5-layer bonded non-woven fleece lining guards your vehicle against torrential rain, harsh UV sun exposure, bird droppings, and paint scratches. Buckle lock straps prevent blowing away during high winds.

specifications.Fabric: 100% Waterproof Oxford Polyester with Cotton Microfleece

specifications.Windproof: Center windproof clip buckle + elasticized hems

products.name: Aerodynamic Smoke Door Window Visors with Chrome Trim - Creta
products.description: Engineered specifically for Hyundai Creta window contours. Allows fresh air ventilation during rain without water ingress and diminishes highway wind buffeting noise. Injection molded virgin polycarbonate with mirror chrome insert.

specifications.Material: High-Grade Optical Polycarbonate with Stainless Chrome Strip

products.name: LuxeGlow 64-Color Symphony App-Controlled Flowing Ambient Lighting
products.description: Factory-integrated look acrylic LED light bars with 64 dynamic RGBIC chasing effects, music synchronization, hidden door and dashboard illumination, and smartphone Bluetooth control.

specifications.Control: iOS/Android App + Wireless Physical Button Switch

products.name: ApexBeam 160W 24,000LM Canbus LED Headlight Conversion Kit (Pair)
products.description: Blinding clarity without blinding oncoming drivers. 160W true output, 6000K pure white daylight beam pattern, integrated copper heat pipe and 12,000 RPM hydraulic silent fan. Zero dashboard error codes with smart Canbus decoder.

specifications.Cooling: Dual Vacuum Pure Copper Core Heat Pipes
specifications.Socket Options: H4, H7, H11, 9005 (Universal automotive bulb sockets)

products.name: ApexLink Pro 2-in-1 Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Dongle
products.description: Say goodbye to tangled dashboard cables. Instantly converts your vehicle’s factory wired CarPlay or Android Auto to 100% wireless. Fast 5.8GHz transmission, 5-second automatic connection upon ignition, and steering control retention.

specifications.Compatibility: Vehicles with factory OEM wired CarPlay/Android Auto
specifications.Port: Includes USB-A and USB-C braided cables

products.name: ApexClean 800 GSM Edgeless Plush Microfiber Towels (Pack of 4)
products.description: Ultra-heavy 800 GSM dual-pile Korean microfiber drying towels. Laser ultrasonic cut edgeless design guarantees 100% scratch-free buffing for delicate clearcoats, wax application, and water drying.

products.name: AutoApex 7D Luxury Molded Floor Mats - Kia Seltos (2019-2025)
products.description: Molded to millimeter precision for the Kia Seltos floorpan. Complete dead-pedal coverage, anti-slip backing nibs, and luxury diamond stitched PU leather with removable upper grass coil mat.

products.name: AeroCross Heavy-Duty Aluminum Roof Rail Crossbars - Scorpio-N
products.description: Aero-wing low drag profile crossbars designed for flush roof rails on the Mahindra Scorpio-N. Supports up to 90kg dynamic roof top tent and luggage carrier load with key-locking security clamps.

specifications.Material: T6 Aviation Aluminum with Anti-Corrosion Anodization
specifications.Security: Integrated Steel Key Lock Cylinders (2 keys)

products.name: ApexFit Executive Nappa Tan Seat Covers for Honda City
products.description: Transform your Honda City cabin into an ultra-luxury sedan lounge. Rich caramel tan Nappa leatherette, perforated climate-flow seating surfaces, dual-density memory foam, and certified side airbag deployment seams.

products.name: ApexWash Super-Foam pH Neutral Citrus Car Shampoo (2 Liters)
products.description: High-lubricity snow foam shampoo engineered for foam cannons and two-bucket washes. Breaks down grime, bugs, and traffic film without stripping delicate wax or ceramic coating layers.

specifications.Safe on: Ceramic coatings, PPF, matte wraps, and bare clearcoat

products.name: SnapFit Magnetic UV Window Sun Shades (Full Set of 4) - Creta
products.description: High-flux neodymium magnetic window sunshades contoured for Hyundai Creta window frames. Blocks 95% of scorching infrared heat and harmful UV rays while preserving outward visibility and allowing windows to roll down.

specifications.Window Functionality: Roll down window freely with shades installed

products.name: SoundApex 1000W Ultra-Slim Compact Active Underseat Car Subwoofer
products.description: Thumping tight bass without sacrificing valuable trunk boot space. Fits discreetly underneath the driver or passenger seat. Features a 10-inch die-cast aluminum woofer, integrated Class-D MOSFET amplifier, and wired dashboard bass volume knob.

specifications.Chassis: Sealed Heavy-Duty Cast Aluminum Heat-Dissipation Enclosure

products.name: Heavy-Duty Anti-Crack Mud Flaps Splash Guards - Tata Nexon
products.description: Molded custom mud flaps to protect lower body panels from rock chips, road tar, and muddy slush. Made of high-flexibility impact modified thermoplastic.

products.name: ApexGrip Hand-Stitched Perforated Carbon Fiber Steering Wrap
products.description: Bespoke hand-stitch DIY steering wheel cover featuring authentic perforated microfiber leather with carbon fiber texture accents and sports red alignment stripe at 12 o’clock. Includes high-tensile needle and bonded wax thread.

specifications.Included: Cover wrap, 2 curved needles, high tensile red thread

products.name: ApexTrack 4G Real-Time Vehicle GPS Tracker with Remote Engine Cut-Off
products.description: Bank-grade vehicle anti-theft tracking module. Live pinpoint satellite tracking with 10-second refresh rate, geo-fencing breach alarms, speeding alerts, route playback, and emergency remote engine immobilizer from your smartphone.

specifications.Features: Remote Relay Engine Kill, Anti-Tow Alarm, Ignition Detect

reviews.title: Flawless fit on my 2024 Creta SX(O)
reviews.comment: The laser measurements are spot-on! No gaps on the dead pedal or side sills. The extra curly grass mat holds dirt and sand perfectly after beach trips. Very premium feel.

reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.comment: Installed them myself in 10 minutes. The metallic heel pad provides great grip under wet shoes.

reviews.title: Crystal clear night footage!
reviews.comment: License plates are completely legible even on dark highways with high beam glare thanks to the Sony Starvis 2 sensor. 5GHz Wi-Fi downloads video clips to iPhone in seconds.

reviews.title: Feels like a ₹50 Lakh luxury SUV interior
reviews.comment: The red contrast stitching and perforated leather look stunning on my Creta. The side airbag test certification gave me full peace of mind.
